fsm_states_mac_tx.name: TX_IDLE
fsm_states_mac_tx.description: No frame to transmit; MAC emits idle; full-duplex so no carrier-sense deferral.

fsm_states_mac_tx.name: TX_IPG
fsm_states_mac_tx.description: Inter-packet gap (nominal 96 BT, adjusted by deficit-idle-count for the multi-lane PCS) before the next frame.

fsm_states_mac_tx.name: TX_PREAMBLE_SFD
fsm_states_mac_tx.description: Emit 7x0x55 preamble + 0xD5 SFD; arm CRC-32 for the next octet.

fsm_states_mac_tx.name: TX_FRAME
fsm_states_mac_tx.description: Emit DA + SA + Type/Length + Payload + Pad; CRC-32 updates each octet.

fsm_states_mac_tx.name: TX_TO_PCS
fsm_states_mac_tx.description: Stream the frame through the RS into the PCS, which 64b/66b-codes, transcodes, scrambles, RS-FEC-encodes and distributes across PCS lanes with alignment markers.

fsm_states_mac_rx.name: RX_IDLE
fsm_states_mac_rx.description: Waiting for CRS or RX_DV from the PHY. RXD ignored.

fsm_states_mac_rx.name: RX_PREAMBLE_LOCK
fsm_states_mac_rx.description: RX_DV asserted; scanning incoming RXD nibbles for the SFD nibble pattern 0xD (last nibble of SFD = 1101). Until SFD is found, accumulate preamble bytes.

fsm_states_mac_rx.name: RX_SFD
fsm_states_mac_rx.description: SFD nibble (0xD) detected; arm CRC-32 engine and start byte-aligned capture into the frame buffer beginning with DA byte 0.

fsm_states_mac_rx.name: RX_FRAME
fsm_states_mac_rx.description: Stream RXD nibbles (or bytes) into the receive FIFO, MAC client framing, and CRC engine. Track byte count for min/max enforcement.

fsm_states_mac_rx.name: RX_FCS_CHECK
fsm_states_mac_rx.description: RX_DV de-asserted (PHY signalled end-of-frame). Compare last 4 captured octets against the CRC-32 of DA + SA + Type/Length + Payload + Pad. On mismatch raise an FCS-error indication.

fsm_states_mac_rx.name: RX_DELIVER
fsm_states_mac_rx.description: FCS good and (length within 64-1518 B for untagged, or 64-1522 B for VLAN-tagged): deliver MAC client data + (DA, SA, Type/Length) tuple to the LLC / IP / VLAN layer.

fsm_states_mac_rx.name: RX_ERROR
fsm_states_mac_rx.description: RX_ER asserted, FCS bad, runt (< 64 B), giant (> 1518/1522 B), or False-Carrier (RXD = 0x1110 with RX_DV = 0 and RX_ER = 1): discard frame, increment the appropriate error counter.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_DISABLE
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: AutoNeg disabled (BMCR 0.12 = 0). Use manual speed + duplex settings.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_ENABLE
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: AutoNeg enabled. Reset state machine; arm AN_TRANSMIT_DISABLE.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_ABILITY_DETECT
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: Begin transmitting FLP bursts encoding ANAR (reg 4) Base Page. Listen for FLP bursts from the partner.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_ACK_DETECT
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: Once at least one full Base Page received, set Acknowledge bit, re-send Base Page until partner acknowledges back.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_COMPLETE_ACK
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: Both ends have acknowledged. If either side has Next-Page bit set, transition to NEXT_PAGE_WAIT; else proceed to IDLE_DETECT.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_NEXT_PAGE_WAIT
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: Exchange Next Page messages (one or more) until both sides clear Next-Page bit.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_IDLE_DETECT
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: Stop FLP transmission; expect a quiet period; resolve the highest common ability via priority table; configure PHY accordingly.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_LINK_OK
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: Move to the negotiated PMA / PMD; BMSR bit 1.5 set; data signaling begins. BMCR 0.9 (Restart AutoNeg) returns the FSM to AN_ABILITY_DETECT.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_PARALLEL_DETECT
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: Fallback when partner does not emit FLP bursts: detect partner's data-link integrity tone (10BASE-T NLP or 100BASE-TX scrambled idle or 100BASE-T4 link beat) and bring up the link in that PMA only (no duplex negotiation; default to half-duplex).

fsm_hints.trigger: TX FSM: leaves TX_IDLE when MAC client asserts a frame-transmit request and the medium is idle (half-duplex) or always (full-duplex). RX FSM: leaves RX_IDLE on RX_DV assertion (or on RX_ER/RXD=0x1110 False Carrier indication). MDIO FSM: STA initiates each transaction; PHY is purely reactive.
fsm_hints.rule: The MAC enforces 96-BT IFG between back-to-back transmits. The PHY emits TX_CLK (MII) or accepts GTX_CLK (GMII) and is responsible for line-coding the nibble/byte stream onto the medium. CRC-32 is computed over DA + SA + Type/Length + Payload + Pad (NOT including preamble + SFD + FCS itself).
fsm_hints.abort: Excessive Collisions (16 retries in half-duplex), Late Collision (post-512-BT), FCS error on RX, RX_ER asserted, Power Down (BMCR 0.11), or Isolate (BMCR 0.10) all force the MAC ↔ PHY data path into an inactive state.

anti_deadlock_rule: 800GbE is full-duplex only, so there is no CSMA/CD collision deadlock case. Progress under congestion is guaranteed by PAUSE / priority-based flow control (the receiver stalls the sender for a bounded pause-quanta interval rather than dropping frames). The PCS guarantees forward progress by deskewing + reordering lanes and by RS-FEC-correcting up to 15 symbol errors per codeword.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On power-on / reset: the PMA SerDes run link training to converge the equaliser on each electrical lane; the PCS then acquires 64b/66b block lock and alignment-marker lock, deskews/reorders the PCS lanes, and enables RS-FEC decode; once the PCS is fully locked and FEC-aligned, the link is reported up via the Clause-45 PCS status MMD and the MAC begins transmitting frames.

default_ready_state_recommendation.TX_idle: TX_EN = 0; TXD = 0x0; TX_ER = 0; PHY in normal-IDLE on the medium (e.g. continuous /I/ /I/ idle code-groups for 100BASE-TX, or no FLP between AutoNeg bursts).
default_ready_state_recommendation.RX_idle: RX_DV = 0; RXD = 0x0; RX_ER = 0; CRS = 0; COL = 0. PHY's receiver still tracks line activity to assert CRS / generate False Carrier.
default_ready_state_recommendation.MDIO_idle: MDC running; MDIO line idle-high (1.5 kΩ PHY pull-up) — no STA driver active.

configurations.name: Half-duplex 10BASE-T / 100BASE-TX
configurations.description: CSMA/CD; CRS + COL active; backoff on collision; max 1 collision domain per shared segment / repeater hub.

configurations.name: Full-duplex 10/100/1000 Mb/s switched
configurations.description: No CSMA/CD; independent TX + RX; CRS / COL ignored; PAUSE-frame flow control.

configurations.name: 1000BASE-T MASTER / SLAVE
configurations.description: 1000BASE-T PHY pair runs a Master/Slave configuration (resolved by reg 9 manual setting or AutoNeg); master sources the symbol clock, slave recovers it; full-duplex on all 4 pairs simultaneously.

configurations.name: MDIO single-PHY / multi-PHY
configurations.description: PHYAD = 00000 always responds (single-PHY); multi-PHY topologies require unique PHYAD per device with the STA driving the MDC + MDIO bus to all of them.

configurations.name: Clause 22 management
configurations.description: 32 × 16-bit register file per PHY; mandatory BMCR + BMSR + PHY ID + ANAR / ANLPAR + ANER.

configurations.name: Clause 45 MMD management
configurations.description: 32 × 32 × 65 536 register file per PHY for gigabit / 10G / EEE / TPS-1 — two-cycle address-then-data MDIO protocol.

timing_dependency_rule: All lanes are recovered clocks (embedded clock per PAM4 lane). The PCS tolerates bounded inter-lane skew via alignment markers + per-lane FIFOs; the RS adapts the 800 Gb/s MAC stream to the PCS lane structure. Management (MDC) is asynchronous to the data path.

fsm_states_pcs.name: PCS_DISTRIBUTE
fsm_states_pcs.description: Round-robin distribute encoded blocks across PCS lanes; insert periodic per-lane alignment markers.

fsm_states_pcs.name: PCS_RX_BLOCK_LOCK
fsm_states_pcs.description: Receiver acquires 64b/66b sync-header lock per lane.

fsm_states_pcs.name: PCS_RX_AM_LOCK
fsm_states_pcs.description: Receiver acquires alignment-marker lock; deskews and reorders PCS lanes.

fsm_states_pcs.name: PCS_RX_FEC_DECODE
fsm_states_pcs.description: RS-FEC(544,514) decode: correct up to 15 symbol errors/codeword; mark uncorrectable codewords; update corrected/uncorrected + symbol-error counters.

fsm_states_pcs.name: PCS_RX_DESCRAMBLE_DECODE
fsm_states_pcs.description: Descramble, 257b/256b un-transcode, 66b/64b decode, reassemble the MAC stream for the RS.

fsm_states_link_training.name: LT_FRAME_LOCK
fsm_states_link_training.description: Acquire training-frame lock on the electrical lane.

fsm_states_link_training.name: LT_ADAPT
fsm_states_link_training.description: Exchange FFE/DFE coefficient request/response; adapt transmitter pre-emphasis + receiver equaliser.

fsm_states_link_training.name: LT_DONE
fsm_states_link_training.description: Receiver-ready exchanged; equaliser converged; release lane to the PCS.

fsm_states_link_training.name: LT_FAIL
fsm_states_link_training.description: Training timer expires before convergence; lane reported not-trained.
